learner_notice: Commit one response before feedback appears.

items.title: Starting check
items.prompt: A vertical axis has equally spaced labels 1, 10, and 100. What operation carries a value one labelled step upward?

items.title: Guided practice
items.prompt: A linear graph moves from (2 trials, 5 units) to (5 trials, 17 units). Enter the slope with units per trial.
items.directions: Enter a number and its rate units.

items.title: Less help
items.prompt: Equally spaced vertical labels read 3, 30, and 300. Which scale rule is encoded?

items.title: On your own
items.prompt: A linear graph includes the points (1, 4) and (4, 16). What is its slope?

items.title: Final near check
items.prompt: A linear distance-time graph moves from 10 meters at 2 seconds to 25 meters at 7 seconds. What is its slope?

items.title: Changed-task check
items.prompt: A logarithmic vertical axis shows 4, 40, and 400 at x = 0, 1, and 2. If the pattern continues, what value appears at x = 3?

items.title: Repair the slope rule
items.prompt: Which expression gives the slope between (2, 7) and (6, 19)?

items.title: Return to the linear check
items.prompt: A fresh linear graph moves from (3 seconds, 20 meters) to (8 seconds, 5 meters). What is its slope?

items.title: Repair the scale rule
items.prompt: Equally spaced labels read 6, 60, and 600. What does one labelled step do?

items.title: Return to the logarithmic check
items.prompt: A fresh logarithmic pattern has values 7 and 70 at consecutive x-values. What is the next value?
